messages:
Asha: Hey team — starting a quick sync on marketplace bootstrap for the 3-cloud listing. I need to confirm who can create the seller accounts + test SKUs.
Liam: I can open the AWS Seller page today. Need the legal EULA text and pricing bands.
Priya: Working on EULA-v2, will push redlines by EOD. Are we doing marketplace trial credentials? Need entitlements language.
Marco: Marketing wants a trial banner and trial sku (14 days). Any constraints from AWS/Azure on trial duration?
Asha: AWS allows trials but must map to AMI/plan. GCP store is more flexible. We should standardize to 14 days across the board.
Rachel: From infra — we need a staging publisher account. @DeployBot can you provision a test account with AMI id placeholder?
DeployBot: Provision request received: publisher-staging-003. ETA: 2 hours. AMI placeholder: ami-testing-0000
Liam: Thx. Also need SKU naming convention. Suggest: redwood-inference.standard.monthly-trial and .enterprise-annual
Priya: Don't include "trial" in SKU metadata visible to customers; use plan_tag:trial. Legal prefers ambiguity to avoid disparate contracts.
Asha: Noted. Marco can you prepare the banner copy but leave pricing numbers out until Priya signs off?
Marco: On it. Draft: "Try Redwood Inference — free 14-day trial, pay-as-you-go afterwards." Will add CTA + docs link.
Priya: Quick legal Q: Any third-party logos in listing? If yes, need proof of permission before submit.
Asha: We plan to include Redwood only. If partners logos show up later, we will start a new asset ticket.
Rachel: For artifacts: manifest.json, AMI list, IAM role names, support email, trial entitlements file. I'll drop a template in the partnership drive.
Liam: Can someone paste the GCP SKU mapping format? I remember it's different (product_id vs sku_id).
Asha: Here's a snippet from previous listing:
```
product_id: redwood-inference
sku_id: redwood-inference-standard-14d
pricing: {unit: token, unit_price: USD 0.0001}
entitlement: trial_14d:true
```
Priya: That looks fine. Add clause: support_response_time: 48h for trial tier.
Marco: @Asha, once DeployBot confirms staging, I'll run a quick listing preview and share screenshots in #partnerships.
DeployBot: publisher-staging-003 ready. AMI ids: ami-testing-0000, ami-testing-0001
Asha: Awesome. Next steps: Priya finalize EULA today; Rachel drop artifacts; Liam open seller consoles (AWS/GCP/Azure); Marco prepare banner + preview. Check-ins tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Liam: noted
Priya: will do
Marco: ping me when preview is up
Rachel: uploading manifest now
Asha: thanks everyone — closing the loop for now.
